test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six persons O, P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a circular arrangement facing the centre of the circle. O is the immediate neighbour of both S and Q. T is sitting second to the right of O and is to the immediate right of Q. P is sitting third to the right of Q. Who among the following is sitting second to the right of Q?
solution: **Given: **Six persons O, P, Q, R, S, and T are sitting in a circular arrangement facing the centre of the circle. 1) T is sitting second to the right of O and is to the immediate right of Q. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/795dfd6cbe7554d35ddb5c16143642866d653ed133989d5a5d98322e3ab071d3.png] 2) O is the immediate neighbour of both S and Q.
